articles.title: Fire crews battled 'heavy' blaze overnight at vacant Toronto building, chief says
articles.summary: Fire crews battled a large blaze in Toronto on Wednesday night that temporarily shut down sections of the Gardiner Expressway and Don Valley Parkway, emergency responders said.

articles.title: Supreme Court hears challenge of law clearing path for Ontario Place redevelopment
articles.summary: OTTAWA — The Supreme Court of Canada plans to hear arguments today from a coalition challenging the constitutionality of legislation that smooths the way for major changes at Ontario Place.

articles.title: 3-alarm fire rips through abandoned building in Riverside
articles.summary: Toronto Fire is investigating after a three-alarm blaze tore through an abandoned building in Riverside on Wednesday night, shutting down parts of the Don Valley Parkway (DVP) and the Gardiner Expressway. articles.summary: A man has been arrested in an alleged hate-motivated assault along the Danforth Tuesday. Police were called to Danforth and Logan avenues for reports of an assault with a weapon. articles.title: Cyclists delay province's bike lane removal start in Toronto, 2 arrested
articles.summary: Cyclists in Toronto delayed work by the province to remove bike lanes on a stretch of Bloor Street W. temporarily this week with a protest that began Tuesday evening and led to two arrests.

articles.title: Kawhi Leonard fits right in with new Raptors teammates as Toronto romps past Knicks
articles.summary: As far as Kawhi Leonard was concerned, his first game with his new Toronto Raptors teammates felt like a seamless fit. Leonard drew the loudest cheers of the night — especially when he scored each of his game-high 21 points — in his re-debut for the Raptors as Toronto rolled past the New York Knicks 148-98 on Tuesday.

articles.title: Why 18 candidates are fighting for this Toronto council seat
articles.summary: With longtime councillor Paula Fletcher stepping down, Ward 14 (Toronto-Danforth) has drawn 18 candidates looking to claim the open seat on city council. CBC’s Dale Manucdoc breaks down the crowded battleground.

articles.title: 2 men charged days after fatal collision in Scarborough: police
articles.summary: Two men have been charged following a fatal collision in Scarborough on Sunday, police say.
